review_mode: Read-only CPU, source and preregistered contract only. No pseudo/real quality summary, scores, fitted-colour visualization or validation winner was inspected. Output material reads were restricted to equality/invariance checks.
source_binding: All five local hashes matched their executed remote source files. Fit/module hashes matched evaluation_contract.json.

contract.timing_wording: Numerical gates were frozen after engineering-only32-step smoke and before formal2000-step fits or pseudo RGB quality inspection. This is not a before-any-fit claim.
contract.timing_evidence_scope: Recorded checkpoint chronology is consistent with the parent-reported before-formal launch order. The reviewer did not independently instrument the first optimizer call.
contract.cases_informativeness: Contract records all left/right/top cases informative using geometry-only counts. No quality score was consumed for this review.

parent_graph.design: Coarse adjacency is evaluated on existing central child0 vertices. Other children receive geometry-checked star edges to their own central vertex. There are no virtual spatial nodes, coarse colour averages or new Gaussian rows.
parent_graph.scale_boundary: Parent-local spacing changes physical adjacency and sheet-gap scale. The source explicitly discloses this discretization/adjacency assumption; this is not proof of true topology or a neural training gain.

real_material_export.source_logic: Current coefficients start from the original full coefficient table. Only propagated unknown-row DC is replaced. Every higher coefficient and every nonzero-row coefficient is preserved; final exported/reloaded equality and operator invariance are checked.
real_material_export.truth_limit: Extended original zero-column colours remain inferred. The real full-data branch is separate from pseudo-case training.

train_and_evaluation_alignment.pseudo_metric: A@decoded_RGB is compared to original RGB on fixed geometry-derived H>=0.9 rows. Mixed rows are separate. The same rows and denominator are used for every method, including unreachable nodes.
train_and_evaluation_alignment.macro: HELD/BUILD macro averages give each of the three cases equal weight.
train_and_evaluation_alignment.real_metric: Real evaluation uses metrics.evaluate_frame/evaluate_pair on original full fixed visible/reviewed/depth masks for all49 frames. It compares the same-frame real M2 median asset with every extension in both keep/delete states.
train_and_evaluation_alignment.frozen_geometry_checks: The real evaluator asserts bitwise equal alpha, depth_sum and all component alpha*T for isolated, keep and delete renders. These assertions are stronger than the frozen5e-6 tolerance.
train_and_evaluation_alignment.domain_wording: Pseudo all_observed is the33331-row eroded fit-core, not the39308-pixel original full a6 core. The separate real render evaluation covers the original full core. Label both domains explicitly.
train_and_evaluation_alignment.premultiplication_wording: Pseudo operator RGB is conditional/normalized. Real black-background isolated RGB is premultiplied and joint scene RGB includes normal compositing. These are separate metrics and should not be numerically conflated.

logical_assessment.leakage: No masked-colour/native-prediction prior path was found in the inspected prepare/fit/extension interfaces. Masked columns and HELD training exclusion also passed independent operator checks.
logical_assessment.quality_status: Quality remains unassessed by this reviewer. COMPLETE_SEALED_MATERIAL_EVALUATION and PASS_FROZEN_GEOMETRY_SCENE_EVALUATION are completion/geometry labels, not automatic passes of the numerical material/preservation gates.
logical_assessment.downstream_gate_requirement: Final acceptance must apply the already frozen evaluation_contract thresholds without reselecting masks, graph rules, seeds or a different per-region winner after inspecting scores.

review_boundaries: Parent geometry barriers are heuristics on sampled PVD geometry and estimated normals.
Training-support colours are regularized inverse estimates, not semantic per-point albedo truth.
Original unknown surfaces have no true hidden RGB target. Same-scene pseudo-occlusion performance cannot certify their true texture.
This review ran no GPU jobs and did not change any original source or prior review artifact.
